lines.text: I'm Chmittens, black-tie silhouette
Three o'clock meeting hasn't happened yet
I watch very violently, perfectly still
Somebody has to run this windowsill
Chmeeze brings one thought to the floor
I keep an eye on him and one on the door
You need the keys? I've got the board
You need the table? I'm already yours
You stand to leave, I take your knee
That's not chance. That's strategy
I'm Mr. Inconvenient
Black tie, no invitation
Right where you're trying to be
I'm Mr. Inconvenient
Boss of the whole operation
But keep a little room for me
Door cracks open, my operation goes live
Tuxedo flying past a hand on either side
Left at the corner, double back, disappear
I won't surrender my hallway frontier
My strong meow could command a fleet
Then I start whining when the pets aren't complete
I climb in your lap; I've dropped the disguise
I'm black tie outside, baby inside
Black tie, no invitation
Right where you're trying to be
I'm Mr. Inconvenient
Boss of the whole operation
But keep a little room for me
Behind my watch, beneath my stare
I only want to find you there
Your hand comes down, my purr begins
I let the quiet take me in
I keep so close because you're home
I never want to love alone
I'm Mr. Inconvenient
Black tie, no invitation
Right where you're trying to be
I'm Mr. Inconvenient
Boss of the whole operation
Keep a little room for me
Door's open. I've got to go.
